author: Plochem
body:
Alright, this is a simple game.

RULES
 1. Regular members (Default, Gold, Emerald, Diamond ) can only increase the number by one.
 2. Media people can count by 2.
 3. MapDevs can count by 3.
 4. All Moderators and Admins will not count, but they also have the power to start the whole counting back to 0.
 
Alright, so I will start with 1.
